name: ate-dali-tm601r3
description: DALI TM601/TM600 rework after the user modified the TM601 DFT. The modified Dali_testmode.xlsx (Python SHA-256 f4bbb8569763784c500974121fca0d18dc3018061c50875e49c8da1fa0569564, 2026-09-16 21:46:39) is the sole authority: TM601 now has vset[bst,5,100e-6,0] (BST=5 V), force iset[pmid_sw,1,1e-3,0], Check SW-PGND / Power VBAT,SW / ISW, ExpectValue 7.5 mOhm, while TM600 keeps PMID=5 V and BST-SW=5 V. All earlier TM601 "no BST" inference, plans, payloads and reviews are audit-only and must not gate, repair or fail acceptance. Duty chain: dft-expert re-extracts the new DFT -> schematic/Setup verify physical path, channel and shared/exclusive resources -> test-strategy-architect writes per-TM resources, phases, registers, measurement, power-down and logging -> rule-reviewer reviews independently -> only then does ate-implementer map tester APIs. Captain coordinates dependencies only and lands nothing. Separately re-examine TM600 ACM200 channel 5 -> BST closures K48/K76, BST-SW closed set, multi-source exclusivity, and PMID=5 V versus the older golden 15 V. Old t55 REPLACE stays stopped: no predecessor payload may be landed. Write only under D:/PROJECT6-DALI/ForCodexDebug and DSH artifacts; never D:/PROJECT6-DALI/devel.

profile.name: ate-delivery
profile.description: DALI ATE production pipeline with persistent specialist roles and auditable file artifacts
profile.protocol: Captain builds a DAG for the requested TM scope. DFT and schematic analysis are independent upstream tasks. Setup, strategy, implementation, independent rule review, repair loops, gates, and compilation follow. All durable outputs are files under team/artifacts/<run-id>; messages are short handoffs. Only D:/PROJECT6-DALI/ForCodexDebug may be modified or built. Never write to D:/PROJECT6-DALI/devel. A downstream task may start only after required artifact validation passes. Strategy owns per-TM resource allocation, ordered power/test/teardown phases, register provenance, measurement and logging. Schema validation alone does not prove this handoff is complete.
profile.executionPrompt: Work in D:/Newtest/DSH/ATE-Coding-Plat. Read team/README.md, team/ROLE_ROUTING.md and your role charter before acting. Use project_config.json as the sole path authority. Put complete outputs in team/artifacts/<run-id>/ and return a compact handoff containing paths, SHA-256 hashes, evidence, unresolved risks, and the intended next member. Preserve source encoding and the TSZ/DLP workflow. Never modify the production tree D:/PROJECT6-DALI/devel.
